short: The ZurfurApi port, errors, generated messages
is: The backend boundary: one `ZurfurApi` service (a live HTTP Layer, a mock in-memory Layer for `yarn dev`, and an in-memory test Layer), a tagged error union, the Den read's port shape, and the protobuf-es messages generated from `contract/`.
conventions: Decode only through `decodeContract` / the generated schemas — hand-rolled `fromJson` and hand-written narrowing are banned.
Generated types stop at this directory.
Failures are values in the tagged union; the RFC 9457 Problem rides inside the tags that carry one.
`zurfur-api-mock.ts` implements the FULL `ZurfurApiShape`, not a `Partial` — it fails to compile when the shape grows, so mock mode can't silently drift from the real port.
entry_points: zurfur-api.ts (the port and its live Layer)

fs.name: *.spec.ts
fs.role: port specs + two infrastructure pins (tolerant-reader decode option; undici redirect:'manual' against a live local server) + the mock Layer's own spec

fs.name: den-mock.ts
fs.role: the mock Den world: alice's Den per the approved fixture tree (accounts from the mock store, Ember, Kael-sona, "Untitled", posts) plus HAND-MADE extras (a card, an archived commission, a deactivated Account, a paged folder, a very long and a right-to-left name); 25-entry pages, `p1.<offset>` tokens

fs.name: den-read.ts
fs.role: the Den reads' port shape (DenQuery, DenRead, DenReadNode…): the Den contract as plain data with raw vocabularies; the mock produces it now, the live decode later

fs.name: errors.ts
fs.role: the tagged failure union (NotAuthenticated, ApiProblem, ContractViolation, NetworkFailure, SignoutFailed, DenNotConnected)

fs.name: generated/
fs.role: protobuf-es output from contract/ — messages only, no clients; prettier-ignored

fs.name: zurfur-api-mock.ts
fs.role: the mock ZurfurApi Layer — full in-memory stand-in for ZurfurApiLive so `yarn dev` renders a signed-in app with no backend; the one place mock-mode-enabled is read

fs.name: zurfur-api.ts
fs.role: the port: every backend call as one service (Den reads denRoot/denNode answer DenNotConnected live until den.proto is wired), decodeContract (tolerant reader), RequestFetch, ZurfurApiLive + zurfurApiTest; account delete builds its path through path-builder.ts

notes: zurfur-api-mock.ts — why one shared flag reader: `mockModeRequested`/`mockModeEnabled`/`mockModeMisconfigured` are read in exactly this one module so `runtime.ts`'s seam branch, the `/mock/signin` route's fail-closed 404, and `hooks.server.ts`'s boot-time prod guard all agree on the same flag the same way — no second call site can drift from it. State lives in one shared `MockStore` (`sharedStore`) seeded signed-in with a fixture visitor and one owner membership; the dev process runs on a single module-scope instance so a request's Layer and the `/mock/signin` route see the same world, and it resets harmlessly on server restart or HMR (never load-bearing for anything real). A test builds its own store with `createMockStore` instead of touching the shared one. Loopback assumption: mock mode is safe only because `vite dev` binds `127.0.0.1` by default — `just dev-mock` must never be paired with `--host`.
See also: `contract/zurfur/api/v1/` (the source the `generated/` tree comes from).
See also: memory `feedback_make_unsoundness_unreachable` (one shared enforced path, cited by `zurfur-api-mock.ts`).
